budgets.source: RAIL-derived budgets (research assumption A6): 500 ms base switch, 100 ms response, two dropped 60 fps frames for pan and tween

gpu.gpu: ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (0x000073DF) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

memory.note: spike 2026-09-27: memory per zone from measureUserAgentSpecificMemory (DOM) and CDP JSHeapUsedSize deltas on the gpu profile; CPU throttling does not change memory

svgRichMaxN.rule: highest n of the longest passing prefix of sw-6x svg-rich rows with mount <= 500 ms, interaction <= 100 ms and pan <= 32 ms (medians)

svgLeanMaxN.rule: same rule over sw-6x svg-lean rows

layoutTweenMaxN.rule: highest n of the longest passing prefix of sw-6x tween frames (svg-rich up to svgRichMaxN, canvas above) with median <= 32 ms

allChordsMaxN.rule: last n of the longest prefix where under 30% of inked pixels are crossed by 4 or more chords (legibility, not speed)

boundaries.canvasDimensionNote: no standalone per-dimension cap reproduced up to 65535 px; clamp on area

webglDecision.reason: Measured 2026-09-28 on sw-6x: the Canvas tier stays within budget over every measured n up to 4000 (canvasTargetN 4000); the all-chords layer is legibility-limited at n = 80. No WebGL tier.
